content:
The Advocates’ Association, Patna High Court celebrated 80th Independence Day with great pride and enthusiasm at Shatabdi Bhawan.

​The ceremony was graced by the Chairman of the Bar Council of India, Shri Manan Kumar Mishra, alongside the President, Secretary General, Joint Secretary, Vice Presidents, former Presidents, former Vice President, executive members, all office bearers, dedicated staff, and the members of the Advocates’ Association. The presence and participation of all the members made the event truly special.

​The celebration was made even more memorable by a lively cultural programme that reflected the spirit of patriotism, unity, and our rich heritage.

​Sharing a few moments from today's event. 🇮🇳 📸👇
